description.value: TwoChiefs is an Indigenous-owned gift and art shop in Chilliwack, BC, officially recognized by Indigenous Tourism BC and majority-owned by Kirkland Douglas of Cheam First Nation. The store carries curated goods — jewellery, apparel, home goods, bath and body products, and kids' items — all made or designed by Indigenous artists whose work carries cultural meaning. A touring cyclist looking for a meaningful souvenir or locally made gift will find this a distinctive stop on the Fraser Valley corridor.
